messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered for SVC-API (svc-123) — error rate 6.2% over 5m. incident: https://incidents.redwood.dev/1793102468

ada-oncall: ack — looking. pulling traces and routing table now. oncall phone: +1-555-0100

mike-sre: any region-specific patterns? i see spike across us-east and eu-west in logs

ada-oncall: quick check: curl -s https://metrics.redwood/api/errors?s=now-10m | jq '.rate' -> 0.062

ada-oncall: mitigation: switching traffic to fallback pool (routed by policy). running:
```
redwood route update svc-123 --pool fallback-pool --dry-run=false
```

jess-prod: confirmed major customers with high TPS hit: acct-514, acct-920, acct-388. potential SLA exposure if >2m outage. we need status page copy and #customers notified

olivia-cs: pls include enterprise contacts in the outbound. i'll prepare support threads. do we have suggested language for reimbursements/credits?

ada-oncall: mitigation in flight, errors dropping. ETA 5-10m. proposed status page update:
"We are investigating elevated error rates affecting the SVC API. We've routed traffic to a fallback pool; partial recovery observed. We will post updates every 30 minutes."

jess-prod: that reads ok. add 'customers may see latencies and 500s for a short period' and 'no data loss'

ada-oncall: updated status copy posted to internal staging: https://status-staging.redwood.dev/incidents/1793102468

jess-prod: question for billing/finance: do we start SLA credit eligibility checks now or after root cause? tagging @billing-bot @finance-ops

billing-bot: Per SLA policy (https://redwood.company/sla): credits apply when sustained error rate causes >99.9% availability breach for a customer over their billing window. Please provide impacted window and affected customers.

finance-ops: we'll calculate pro rata credits once you give start/end times + account list. also need plan tier for each account.

sam-sales: heads up — acct-514 is on enterprise contract with negotiated penalties. pls loop in their AM immediately.

ada-oncall: errors <1% now. rollback diff applied at 1793106280. Current error rate 0.9% and trending down. Monitoring for 15m.

jess-prod: good work. can we draft a customer notice for enterprise and standard customers? olivia, can you assemble templates? include next steps and credit eligibility note.

olivia-cs: draft below, please review:
"Hello [Customer],
We experienced elevated errors on SVC API starting at 2026-05-02T15:34:28Z. We implemented a traffic reroute and mitigations at 2026-05-02T17:18:00Z. If you observed impact, you may be eligible for a pro rata service credit per our SLA. Our finance team will reach out with details. We apologize for the disruption."

jess-prod: change timestamps to unix? prefer human-readable + timezone. add 'no customer data was lost' line.

olivia-cs: updated template with 'no customer data was lost' and placeholders for AM contact.

finance-ops: please confirm final impacted window. we need start_ts and end_ts to compute credits. also include plan tiers: 'enterprise/professional/standard'.

ada-oncall: final timeline: start 1793102468, mitigation 1793106280, monitoring end 1793108520. marking incident resolved if metric stays stable for 30m. :white_check_mark:

jess-prod: approved. i'll publish customer notice to impacted accounts and post a public status update referencing incident id 1793102468. i'll bcc AMs and support.

nate-engineering: i'll own the postmortem and RCA. will schedule follow-up with infra to prevent routing regression. owner: nate-engineering.

finance-ops: we'll handle credit apportionment and billing adjustments. expect a CSV request for accounts and tiers in this thread.

ada-oncall: thanks all. handing off to night oncall at 1793108520 — @mike-sre please take over monitoring and customer comm sync if anything re-surges.

mike-sre: oncall ack. will monitor dashboards and escalate if trend rises.

incident-bot: Incident 1793102468 - RESOLVED. Duration: 1h44m (start 1793102468, end 1793108520). Postmortem assigned to nate-engineering. Link: https://incidents.redwood.dev/1793102468/postmortem
